evidence.mission_note: It is a manual, affordable and resellable roadster, but it is an MX-5 Miata, which Jason has explicitly excluded, so it cannot fulfil the enthusiast-bridge brief as he defined it. It would serve only if he deliberately revisits that exclusion.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a VIN-confirmed 1999 NB Miata with a 5-speed manual, a factory hardtop and a stock configuration. The odometer photo is consistent with the July 2026 service mileage. Recent documented work is limited to plugs, an A/C belt, a window regulator and a 2023 valve cover gasket. Observed issues: a Carfax minor-damage event in November 2022 with no repair records, and the seller's account varies between bumper-only in the listing and bumper plus hood in the comments. The main open items are the timing-belt age on an interference engine, underbody rust on a Pennsylvania car, cooling-system age, tire dates, and a CA smog path. The buyer profile provided covers the NA generation; its crank-nose issue does not apply to this NB, but its belt, rust, cooling and soft-top guidance does. Independently of condition, the model sits on Jason's active exclusion list.
